messages:
incident-bot: P1 — Hydra Corp (hydra-privnet-us-west-2). Dedicated pool hydra-dedicated-02 reporting high 5xx rate and NLB target timeouts. NAT gateway natgw-01 showing packet drops and conntrack growth. Pager: oncall-infra.

alice_oncall: ACK. I9m on it and will lead. Rafa (network oncall) can you join? Maya (support) please loop in customer comms.

rafa_network: joining. Quick look: natgw-01 conntrack table fills at 09:12:xx UTC, correlates with spike in SYN_RECV and TCP resets from tenant subnet 10.2.7.0/24. NLB target group reports increased backend resets, instances themselves pass local health checks. Checking route table and TG config.

maya_support: Hydra SRE emailed: "we started seeing 502/timeout errors at ~09:10 UTC, many retries from our clients." They want an ETA and next steps.

alice_oncall: initial hypothesis: SNAT/conntrack exhaustion on natgw-01 causing asymmetric/failed handshakes -> NLB timeouts. Immediate plan: (A) isolate the affected tenant subnet to limit blast radius, (B) divert a portion of traffic to fallback pool, (C) temporarily relax aggressive healthcheck cadence.

ben_sre: I can do a controlled routing weight shift to hydra-fallback-pool-1 and put a soft rate limit in front of the pool. Will coordinate with Rafa before making route changes.

ton y_prodops: deploy-bot: routing.canary request queued (20% -> fallback pool). Manual approval required.

alice_oncall: approve canary 20%. Ben, apply shift now. Rafa, prepare route-level isolation for 10.2.7.0/24.

ben_sre: executing shift:
```
# route weight shift to fallback pool
infractl route set-weight --from hydra-dedicated-02 --to hydra-fallback-pool-1 --weight 20 --note "egress-containment"
```
Shift started, watching errors and tailing access logs.

rafa_network: preparing subnet isolation: creating a temporary route override to natgw-02 and tagging for rollback. Plan to switch in 45s. Also checking if any NLB cross-zone/loadbalancer stickiness prevents immediate failover.

maya_support: sent customer interim: "We9re isolating a subset of your traffic and routing to a fallback pool to restore requests. No data plane changes. Will follow up with RCA." Hydra SRE replied: "thanks, please advise when stable."

alice_oncall: signal: error rate fell from ~22% -> ~7% after initial canary. Good. Hold further weight increases for 5m while we validate traces.

rafa_network: route flip live. Replaced default route for rtb-0a1b2c3 with natgw-02 for ten-7 (10.2.7.0/24). Command:
```
aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-0a1b2c3 --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id natgw-02
```
I also observed some long-lived flows still SNAT
'd to natgw-01 (likely established pre-switch). Planning target drain of instances behind natgw-01 to clear state.

ben_sre: started draining targets in tg-hydra-dedicated-02. Will remove from NLB gracefully over 300s. Also applying front-door token bucket limiter at 50rps for tenant pool to prevent re-exhaustion.

deploy-bot: config-change: increased NLB healthcheck interval to 10s (from 5s) on tg-hydra-dedicated-02 to reduce flapping during drain.

rafa_network: proposing a scoped security-group exception to allow direct keepalives from 10.2.7.0/28 -> instance:443 for 20 minutes to help in-flight handshake completion. Security policy flagged this as deviating; request approval for emergency exception.

alice_oncall: approve one-time SG exception for 10.2.7.0/28 to instance:443 for 20m. Documented in incident notes. Maya, tell the customer we applied a temporary exception.

maya_support: message sent: "Temporary network exception applied to speed recovery for a targeted subset of flows. We9ll revert once traffic stabilizes." Hydra SRE: "ack".

ben_sre: after drain + canary, overall errors down to 0.5% (from 22%). Traces show completed retries for many failed requests. Front-door limiter appears to prevent the re-trigger.

rafa_network: after isolation, natgw-01 conntrack cleared gradually; natgw-02 handling new flows. No evidence of asymmetric routing for new connections. Drained instances behind natgw-01 are at 0 active connections.

alice_oncall: containment achieved. Next actions: (1) keep canary at 20% for another 10m, (2) schedule NAT capacity increase or dedicate NAT per high-volume tenant, (3) revert SG exception after 20m and confirm stability, (4) prepare postmortem (RCA = NAT conntrack exhaustion triggered by sudden spike of long-lived connections/noisy tenant flow).

deply-bot: scheduled rollback: canary -> 0% at +10m if no regressions.

ben_sre: will move canary to 0% if metrics hold. I9ll attach graphs and sample trace IDs to the incident.

maya_support: customer notified of mitigation success; Hydra requested an RCA meeting. Meeting scheduled for 2024-11-07 16:00 UTC.

alice_oncall: incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. I9ll own the postmortem and the follow-up mitigation ticket (increase conntrack limits / dedicated NAT / rate-limits per tenant). Thanks all, standing down from page unless regressions. :white_check_mark:
